name: Andrea Lozano Barragán v Colombia (Amazon)

jurisdiction.court: Corte Suprema de Justicia (Supreme Court of Justice), Sala de Casación Civil (Civil Cassation Chamber)

description: Acción de tutela brought by 25 minors and young people (led by Andrea Lozano Barragán) against the Presidency of the Republic, the Ministries of the Environment and of Agriculture and the governors of the Amazonian departments, concerning the growing deforestation of the Colombian Amazon and the related greenhouse gas emissions and degradation of air quality, invoking the rights to life, health and a healthy environment of present and future generations.
outcome: Petition granted. The Civil Chamber recognised for the first time in the world the Colombian Amazon as a “subject of rights” entitled to protection, conservation and restoration. Ordered: an Action Plan against deforestation, an “Intergenerational Pact for the Life of the Colombian Amazon” (PIVAC) and the updating of territorial planning plans. First climate tutela in Latin America founded on the principles of precaution, intergenerational equity and solidarity.
